posts.text:
There's a political question here, as Trump advocates are calling on the Fed to ignore PCE and just focus on CPI.

And a media one! Since CPI gets the coverage, it is easy to think inflation is lower. Meanwhile media barely covers PCE, which is raging. 2/2 newsletter.mikekonczal.com/p/is-the-act...
posts.summary: Trump advocates push misleading inflation narrative by favoring CPI over PCE

posts.text:
New piece on the most interesting inflation question I think is out there. It's debated in some circles, but is definitely missing from the general discourse and coverage:

is inflation CPI, and thus near its target, or PCE, and so high and above target it deserve hikes? /1
posts.summary: PCE inflation remains elevated and above target, missing from mainstream discourse
